title: Profile-aware diagnostics of discarded parameter-Hessian mass
abstract: arXiv:2611.01335v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Evaluating block-diagonal curvature models involves two questions: how much curvature they omit, and what a specific correction changes at a finite step. We measure the squared off-block fraction of the parameter Hessian against references for group sizes and the observed within-group curvature profile. In CIFAR-100 ResNet-18 and a skip-free counterpart, similar initial discarded fractions accompany different profiles. At saved trained ResNet-18 weights, changing from stage to layer groups moves estimated off-block mass from below to above the profile envelope; an approximate conditional screen resolves this comparison in all six seed/input cells, while some skip free comparisons remain unresolved. Separately, in saved ResNet-50/Stanford Cars states, we compare candidates formed from off-group Hessian action, the remaining model residual and their combination through the same Hessian-informed map. At unit scale off-group input alone

translated_title: 轮廓感知的被丢弃参数Hessian质量诊断
translated_abstract: 评估块对角曲率模型涉及两个问题：它们省略了多少曲率，以及一个特定的修正在有限步长内改变了什么。我们针对不同组规模以及观测到的组内曲率轮廓的参考基准，测量参数Hessian的块外平方占比。在CIFAR-100的ResNet-18及其无跳跃连接的对应模型中，相似的初始丢弃占比伴随着不同的曲率轮廓。在已保存的训练好的ResNet-18权重处，将分组方式从阶段组改为层组，会使估计的块外质量从轮廓包络之下移动到其之上；一个近似条件筛选方法在所有六个种子/输入单元中都解决了这一比较问题，而某些无跳跃连接模型之间的比较仍未得出结论。另外，在已保存的ResNet-50/Stanford Cars状态下，我们通过相同的Hessian信息映射，比较了由组外Hessian作用、剩余模型残差以及二者组合所构成的候选修正。在单位尺度下，仅组外输入（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出一种轮廓感知的诊断框架，通过在不同分组规模和组内曲率轮廓参考下测量参数Hessian的块外平方占比，来量化块对角曲率模型所丢弃的曲率质量，并评估候选修正的实际效果。
en_tdlr: Proposes a profile-aware diagnostic framework that quantifies the curvature mass discarded by block-diagonal curvature models by measuring the squared off-block fraction of the parameter Hessian against group-size and within-group curvature-profile references, and evaluates candidate corrections under the same Hessian-informed map.
